critical_code_review_comments: stepMonth() inside the Monthly Payroll IIFE (line ~441) calls setPayslipMonth/setPayslipYear and then immediately calls onRefreshPayslips(). Because React state updates are async, the refresh fires with the still-old month/year if onRefreshPayslips captures the parent state via closure. Currently works because the parent must already be re-fetching off useEffect on payslipMonth/payslipYear; if not, prev/next would refresh stale month. Confirmed working in UI but worth defending with useEffect on [payslipMonth, payslipYear] inside the parent.

PayrollManagementTab.js is 2369 lines — exceeds the 700-line file-size guideline. Recommend splitting the Monthly Payroll block (and its modal) into a separate MonthlyPayrollTab.js component. Improves maintainability and lets the IIFE return become a proper component with its own hooks.

Year select uses yearsForEmployee(selectedEmployee) — when no employee is selected (the case on the Monthly tab) this still works because of the helper's fallback, but conceptually the year list should be global on this tab (e.g., 2024..currentYear+1). Worth renaming/extracting to yearsForMonthlyPayroll() to avoid implicit coupling.
